title.zh: 消化器病：消炎诱导、调节胃肠神经与背俞—足三里
title.en: Digestive Diseases: Anti-inflammation by Induction, Regulating Gut Nerves, Back-shu with Zusanli

summary.zh: 消化器病是处方集最大的内科章(45条)。口咽炎症以“消炎诱导”、颈项上肢穴重刺激；胃肠功能病则按神经状态分向：亢进者镇静(强刺激缓解发作)，衰弱者强壮(轻中刺激加灸，久治)。骨架是肝俞、脾俞、三焦俞等背俞配中脘、天枢与足三里(26条)，两组穴交换；腹部宜浅刺或不针，癌肿、腹膜炎、中毒等转专医。
summary.en: The largest internal-medicine chapter (45 entries). Oral and pharyngeal inflammations: anti-inflammation by induction with strong stimulation at neck and upper-limb points. Functional gut disease goes by nerve state: overactive is calmed (strong stimulation to break attacks), weak is strengthened (light-to-moderate stimulation plus moxa, long treatment). The frame is back-shu (Ganshu, Pishu, Sanjiaoshu) with Zhongwan, Tianshu and Zusanli (26 entries), two groups alternated; the abdomen is needled shallowly or not at all; cancer, peritonitis and poisoning go to a specialist.

takeaways.zh: 口腔、咽头、耳下腺的急性炎症一律“以消炎诱导为目的”(该句在7条中出现，含口腔炎、耳下腺炎、扁桃腺炎、急性咽炎和直肠炎)，取风池、天柱、大杼、曲池、手三里、合谷等颈项上肢穴，用26号针“重刺激”，扁桃腺炎取少商、商阳，急性咽炎则明写少商、商阳出血；转入慢性时才换28号针中等刺激，慢性咽炎目的也变为“消炎强壮”。
takeaways.en: Acute inflammation of mouth, pharynx and parotid is uniformly aimed at anti-inflammation by induction (the phrase heads seven entries, including proctitis), at neck and upper-limb points such as Fengchi, Tianzhu, Dazhu, Quchi, Shousanli, Hegu, with a No. 26 needle and heavy stimulation; tonsillitis adds Shaoshang and Shangyang, and acute pharyngitis has them bled; only chronic cases change to No. 28 moderate stimulation, and chronic pharyngitis is aimed at anti-inflammation plus strengthening.

takeaways.zh: 胃肠功能病的目的写成“调节自主神经”，方向随状态而定：胃痉挛“镇静胃之副交感神经”；胃肌衰弱“加强副交感神经之兴奋，抑制交感神经”；神经性消化不良“调整交感神经之紧张”；肠弛缓“抑制肠部交感神经之紧张”。同一套穴位，靠强度与灸来分“镇”与“强”。
takeaways.en: For functional stomach and gut disease the aim is written as autonomic regulation, its direction set by the state: gastric spasm calms the parasympathetic; weak stomach muscle strengthens parasympathetic excitation and inhibits the sympathetic; nervous dyspepsia adjusts sympathetic tension; atonic bowel suppresses sympathetic tension. The same point sets serve both, distinguished by intensity and moxa.

takeaways.zh: 慢性、衰弱型病以“强壮”为目的，必须久治：慢性胃炎“必须作长久之治疗”，可取肝俞、脾俞、中脘、足三里每日灸小炷各五壮“持久不辍”；神经性消化不良“需二三个月以上之针疗”；胃下垂“唯先天性者，久治亦难有效果”，肠狭窄“年久者难愈”。
takeaways.en: Chronic and weak types are aimed at strengthening and need long treatment: chronic gastritis "must be treated for a long time", and Ganshu, Pishu, Zhongwan, Zusanli with five small cones daily "without interruption" is also good; nervous dyspepsia needs two or three months or more; congenital gastroptosis stays refractory, long-standing intestinal stenosis is hard to cure.

takeaways.zh: 取穴骨架：足三里出现于有穴位的43条中的26条；背俞以肝俞(17)、三焦俞(16)、脾俞(15)为主，另有胃俞、大肠俞、气海俞；颈背上部大杼(14)、天柱(13)、风池(11)、膈俞(13)；腹部中脘(12)、气海(11)、天枢(10)。8条把穴位分成两组“交换”或“轮换”针治(如慢性胃炎、胃痉挛、胃溃疡、肝硬化)。
takeaways.en: Skeleton: Zusanli in 26 of the 43 entries that list points; back-shu led by Ganshu (17), Sanjiaoshu (16), Pishu (15), plus Weishu, Dachangshu, Qihaishu; upper neck-back Dazhu (14), Tianzhu (13), Fengchi (11), Geshu (13); abdomen Zhongwan (12), Qihai (11), Tianshu (10). Eight entries split the points into two groups "alternated" (chronic gastritis, gastric spasm, gastric ulcer, cirrhosis and others).

takeaways.zh: 强度按急缓分：发作或急性时用强刺激(急性胃炎的四肢穴、胃痉挛发作取足三里、公孙、厉兑、神经性呕吐取大陵、肠疝痛、胆石痛，共11条提到强刺激)，平时与衰弱型改轻、中刺激(7条明写轻刺激)，并加灸(18条用灸，9条用“念盈药艾灸条”，3条用温针)。
takeaways.en: Intensity follows acute versus chronic: at an attack or acute stage strong stimulation (limb points in acute gastritis; Zusanli, Gongsun, Lidui at a gastric spasm attack; Daling in nervous vomiting; intestinal colic; biliary colic — 11 entries name strong stimulation), between attacks and in weak types light or moderate (7 entries state light), with moxa added (18 entries use moxa, 9 the proprietary medicated moxa stick, 3 warmed needle).

takeaways.zh: 腹部要慎：胃溃疡“禁止胃部深针”；急性肠炎腹腔之穴“浅刺轻针”；急性胃炎中脘“宜浅刺而留针”；腹膜炎“于腹腔部绝对避免用针”；腹水腹部诸穴“概不用针，只用……灸治”；脾肿大若为脾癌肿“绝对禁止局部刺针”。腹水一条即以灸代针。
takeaways.en: Care over the abdomen: no deep needling of the stomach region in gastric ulcer; shallow light needling of abdominal points in acute enteritis; shallow retained needling at Zhongwan in acute gastritis; peritonitis, absolutely no needling of the abdomen; ascites, no abdominal needling, only moxa; enlarged spleen from splenic cancer, no local needling at all. In ascites moxa replaces the needle on the abdomen.

takeaways.zh: 他为针灸划出转诊界线：食管癌是“针灸术不适应症”，胃癌针“只可作缓解疼痛之暂时设法”，腹膜炎属不适应证(仅局限性慢性者可作药物辅助)，盲肠炎、急性中毒性胃肠炎、痔的彻底治法须专医；肝硬化、黄疸、胆石痛、腹水则强调“与专医配合药物治疗”。全章有18条在处方或调护里提到专医、药物或手术。
takeaways.en: He draws referral lines: oesophageal cancer is "not an indication for acupuncture", in gastric cancer needling can only give temporary pain relief, peritonitis is not indicated (only localized chronic cases as a drug adjunct), appendicitis, toxic gastroenteritis and definitive treatment of haemorrhoids belong to a specialist; cirrhosis, jaundice, biliary colic and ascites are to be co-treated with a specialist's drugs. Eighteen entries mention specialist, drugs or surgery in the prescription or care text.

takeaways.zh: 调护与预后紧贴病因：调护以饮食为主(30条提到食物，如禁刺激性食物、少食多餐、温开水)，其次是情志(8条，如神经性消化不良“情志愉快为第一”)、腹部保温、背腹按摩；预后常写“视原因之不同”“去其原因，能久治者，良”，神经性消化不良“生命上无危险，但为顽固”，胃溃疡“如有并发症者危险”。
takeaways.en: Care and prognosis track the cause: care lines are mostly about food (30 entries: no irritating food, small frequent meals, warm water), then mood (8 entries; nervous dyspepsia "a cheerful mind comes first"), abdominal warmth and massage; prognosis is often "depends on the cause" or "good if the cause is removed and treatment is long"; nervous dyspepsia is no danger to life but stubborn; ulcer with complications is dangerous.

title.en: Digestive: disease → aim → key points → technique → prognosis

caveats.zh: 病名与解剖为民国西医名词(卡他性、亚布答性口内炎、胃扩张、肠疝痛、虫样突起炎等)，自主神经(交感、副交感)的调节说是他当时的解释框架。“念盈药艾灸条”是书中出现的成药艾条，按原文保留。大蒜片隔麝香灸治胃癌一段是他自述的“姑作万一幸效之试验”，并非既有疗法，不可当作主张。药物辅助方(锡类散、参三七等)属他附记的经验，不列入穴位思路。
caveats.en: Disease names and anatomy are Republican-era Western terms, and autonomic (sympathetic and parasympathetic) regulation is his framework of the day. "Nianying medicated moxa stick" is a proprietary product named in the text and kept as printed. The garlic-slice and musk moxa for gastric cancer is his own admitted last-ditch experiment, not an established method. Drug adjuncts (Xilei San, Sanqi etc.) are his side notes and not part of the point logic.
